policy.role: specialized reference for agents, never an authority
precedence: docs/governance/plans/saleor-source-pins.json — the pinned Saleor 3.23.43 reference schema (blob-verified) and the Dashboard pins
docs/governance/plans/saleor-dashboard-full-commerce-canonical-plan.md — the D-SALEOR-FULL-001 canonical plan and its domain matrix

policy.conflictRule: A skill text never overrides any precedence layer. A discovered conflict is registered in saleor-contract-divergences.csv through a reviewed PR; it is never silently adopted into code.
policy.updates: Vendored skill content moves only by a reviewed PR that updates this registry in the same change (the same discipline as productionPinsMoveOnlyByReviewedChange in saleor-source-pins.json).

knownUpstreamErrata.issue: the Python snippet uses unit_discount_reason without initializing it
knownUpstreamErrata.verifiedFact: the pinned upstream source saleor/discount/utils/order.py at 3.23.43 initializes unit_discount_reason from discount.reason before the calculation (lines 126-129); the snippet is not copy-paste runnable

knownUpstreamErrata.issue: the text locates StockQuerySet in saleor/warehouse/managers.py
knownUpstreamErrata.verifiedFact: that path does not exist at 3.23.43; StockQuerySet and the for_channel / for_channel_and_country methods live in saleor/warehouse/models.py (lines 329/440/377)

knownUpstreamErrata.issue: the rounding bound is phrased as 'at most a cent', which is blind to the currency's exponent
knownUpstreamErrata.verifiedFact: flagged by the 2026-10-30 CodeRabbit review of PR #771; agents must treat the authoritative rounding rule as currency-precision-bound, not cent-bound
knownUpstreamErrata.evidence: CodeRabbit review 2026-10-30 (PR #771); verify against saleor/saleor@3.23.43 when consumed

knownUpstreamErrata.issue: the legacy-mode description attaches four shipping conditions to every Stock row
knownUpstreamErrata.verifiedFact: flagged by the 2026-10-30 CodeRabbit review: for_channel_and_click_and_collect returns channel warehouses without requiring shipping-zone linkage, and for_channel_and_country includes click-and-collect warehouses when country_code is empty or include_cc_warehouses is true
knownUpstreamErrata.evidence: CodeRabbit review 2026-10-30 (PR #771); verify against saleor/saleor@3.23.43 when consumed

knownUpstreamErrata.issue: conflates accepting a GraphQL subscription with delivering its events
knownUpstreamErrata.verifiedFact: flagged by the 2026-10-30 CodeRabbit review: subscriptions can be created in legacy mode while the four stock events are only delivered when useLegacyShippingZoneStockAvailability is disabled and the event fires
knownUpstreamErrata.evidence: CodeRabbit review 2026-10-30 (PR #771); verify against saleor/saleor@3.23.43 when consumed

knownUpstreamErrata.issue: claims one unified per-destination answer inside channel countries for the triple warehouse/channel/shipping-zone setting
knownUpstreamErrata.verifiedFact: flagged by the 2026-10-30 CodeRabbit review: legacy mode keeps stock visibility dependent on the customer destination country being covered by the warehouse's shipping zone; direct mode removes the destination dependence
knownUpstreamErrata.evidence: CodeRabbit review 2026-10-30 (PR #771); verify against saleor/saleor@3.23.43 when consumed
